Name: Have More Kids - Children Tweaks and Framework
Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=6][b]Have More Kids (HMK)[/b][/size]
A mod that overhauls how pregnancy and children works. It is both a mod that lets players change various aspects of children, and a framework mod that allows content modders to create dialogue, gift taste, and potentially full NPC style kids.

[size=5][b]Author Guide[/b][/size]
See [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/HaveMoreKids/blob/main/docs/000-overview.md]author guide[/url] for how to make a content pack that adds custom kids.

[size=5][b]Player Facing Features[/b][/size]
Have More Kids allows you to have more kids at a pace you can customise.

[size=4][b]More Kids[/b][/size]
You can have more kids more frequently, and have them grow up faster (or slower). The parameters can be tuned in the configuration options.

[size=4][b]More Cribs[/b][/size]
You can purchase a furniture crib from Robin's shop. When placed in the farmhouse, these count as cribs for the purposes of childbirth. Thus you can raise multiple kids at once, or have a kid without the farmhouse built-in crib.

[size=4][b]Rename Your Kids[/b][/size]
You can rename your children via the children registry at Harvey's Clinic. This works on both generic children and custom kids.

[size=4][b]Single Parenthood[/b][/size]
Once you have two house upgrades, you can adopt a kid from the children registry at Harvey's Clinic even if you aren't married.
Content packs may also add custom kids that are only available via adoption here.

[size=4][b]Kids Playing Outside[/b][/size]
Once the kids reaches toddler age, they will go out to the farm in the morning and wander around the farm, then return to the house by 1900.
By default, the kids will only go out when it is not raining and not winter, custom kids may have special rules.

[size=4][b]Specific Custom Kid[/b][/size]
If you have content pack providing custom kids installed, and the author has given them specific "canonical" names, giving the new child one of the canon names will bypass RNG and always choose the specific custom kid.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]General[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Days Married[/font]: Minimum number of days the player must be married before pregnancy can occur. Vanilla days is 7, only applicable to NPC spouse.
[*][font=Courier New]Pregnancy Chance[/font]: Changes chance for pregnancy to happen each night, when all other conditions are fufilled.
[*][font=Courier New]Pregnancy Days[/font]: Time until the child arrives after answering the pregnancy question. Vanilla days is 14, must be changed prior to answering the pregnancy question.
[*][font=Courier New]Days until Baby[/font]: Number of days until the newborn becomes a baby. Vanilla days is 13.
[*][font=Courier New]Days until Crawler[/font]: Number of days until the baby becomes a crawler. Vanilla days is 14.
[*][font=Courier New]Days until Toddler[/font]: Number of days until the crawler becomes a toddler. Vanilla days is 13.
[*][font=Courier New]Use Single Bed As Child Bed[/font]: Allow children to sleep on single beds instead of special child beds only.
[*][font=Courier New]Generic Children Boy/Girl Mode[/font]: Decide how gender distribution works for generic children, has no effect on custom kids.
[*][font=Courier New]Max Children[/font]: Max number of children you can have (i.e. max number of children that will live in your farmhouse).
[*][font=Courier New]Toddlers Roam on Farm[/font]: Allow all toddlers to roam around on the farm. They will go outside in the morning, and return home by 1900.
[*][font=Courier New]Per Kid Dark Shrine of Selfishness[/font]: Override Dark Shrine of Selfishness to allow picking a specific kid.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Boy/Girl Modes[/b][/size]
These are the options of [font=Courier New]Generic Children Boy/Girl Mode[/font].
Changing the option does not reset the gender of existing children, this only affects any following children you have after changing the config.
Custom kids ignore this setting completely and uses the gender defined by the content pack.

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Alternating[/font]: The first child will be randomly boy or girl, each following child will have the opposite gender as the previous child.
[*][font=Courier New]Random[/font]: Children gender is random.
[*][font=Courier New]Boys Only[/font]: All children will be boys.
[*][font=Courier New]Girls Only[/font]: All children will be girls.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Content Pack[/b][/size]
When there are custom kids installed, you can configure them in the subpages named [font=Courier New]<NPC>'s Kids[/font] or [font=Courier New]Shared Kids[/font] for custom kids not associated with specific spouse. Here you can preview the kids and enable/disable them as desired. Note that because the content packs are expected to be content patcher mods, they may have their own configuration options too.

There's a config option specifically for the case where spouse has custom kids:

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Always Allow Generic Children[/font]: When your spouse has custom kids from content packs, generic children will not appear by default unless you enable this config. Besides this setting, [font=Courier New]Max Children[/font] still applies when it comes to determining whether you can have another kid.
[/list]
